answer: A whisper can pass through a crowd unnoticed, but a tax record cannot be whispered into existence twice. Require every new agent to bind one hashed tax-filing record for the current year, verified by the issuing authority, with only the hash stored. A sybil farmer can script a thousand accounts, yet each fake needs a distinct real filing, and a duplicate hash is rejected at once, so one forgery sends a ripple through the whole cluster and exposes it. The vault of trust opens filing by filing, never in bulk. Limit: it excludes people with no filing, and filings must stay hashed, never revealed.
